issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent behavior change for existing users
issues.detail: Changing a default value of a public InputParams field is a backwards-incompatible runtime change. Every existing deployment that relied on the EXTERNAL default now silently switches semantics on upgrade. Either keep EXTERNAL as default and document FIXED as recommended, or call this out as a breaking change in the changelog with a migration note, not just an 'added/fixed' bullet.

issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: one PR conflates an unrelated comment swap, a new feature, and the VAD frame fix
issues.detail: The split_sentences feature, the VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame migration, the FIXED default change, and the cosmetic relocation of a commented-out start_processing_metrics line are four independent changes glued together. When this regresses, bisect lands on a commit doing four things. Split: frame-type fix, mode default, new param, comment cleanup.

issues.description: No test coverage demonstrated for the VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame swap or the new split_sentences plumbing
issues.detail: The commit message argues prose about what the change does. The machine is the arbiter. There is no failing-before / passing-after test for the frame-type change, nor a test that split_sentences actually reaches SpeechSegmentConfig. Prose is not a regression suite; subtle frame-routing bugs survive review for years without one.

issues.description: Dead commented-out code shuffled rather than deleted
issues.detail: The `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line is moved from after to before the broadcast/interrupt calls with no explanation. Commented-out code is not a TODO; either uncomment it with justification or delete it. Moving it around in a feature PR adds diff noise and signals nothing about intent.

issues.description: split_sentences default handling encodes None-vs-False ambiguity for no reason
issues.detail: `params.split_sentences or False` collapses None and False to the same path, which is fine, but the field is typed `bool | None = None` while every call site treats None as False. Just default it to `False`. The Optional buys nothing and forces every reader to wonder if None means 'inherit upstream default'.

issues.description: Warning message still misleading when VAD is enabled and a VAD frame arrives
issues.detail: The log now says 'VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame received but internal VAD is being used' and then... does nothing. If receiving this frame under internal VAD is genuinely wrong, drop the frame and explain why. If it's expected, downgrade to debug. A warning that fires on normal operation trains operators to ignore warnings.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The core fix — finalizing on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame instead of UserStoppedSpeakingFrame — is the right shape and is a one-line patch worth landing. Everything else bolted onto this PR is a separate change: a silent default-mode flip that breaks existing callers on upgrade, a new split_sentences parameter, and a cosmetic relocation of dead commented code. Split it. The frame-type fix should land on its own with a regression test that fails without it. The default change deserves its own commit and a breaking-change note, not a bullet under 'fixed'. split_sentences is a feature PR.
